name: html-css-to-image
description: Create images, PDFs, and HTML-to-video animations; record scrolling websites; and render reusable templates with HTML/CSS to Image.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a simple request into polished images, website screenshots, PDFs, and videos—without leaving your AI assistant. HTML/CSS to Image combines flexible browser-based rendering with natural-language control, helping developers, marketers, and content teams create consistent visual assets faster.

Use it to:

- Create social graphics, product images, reports, certificates, and other branded assets from HTML and CSS
- Capture website screenshots for previews, documentation, testing, and visual QA
- Turn structured HTML/CSS into marketing videos, animated social graphics, and GIFs
- Record scrolling website walkthroughs and review sticky headers, clipping, lazy loading, and responsive layouts
- Produce personalized images at scale with reusable, versioned templates and dynamic variables
- Generate image batches across responsive dimensions, time zones, color schemes, and other variations in one workflow
- Export images to PNG, JPG, WebP, or PDF with viewport, selector, and rendering controls
- Export recordings to MP4, WebM, or GIF with duration, actions, frame-rate, and output-scale controls
- Keep your rendering pipeline under your control with organization-level resources:
  - Deliver rendered files directly to your own Amazon S3 or S3-compatible storage
  - Route renders through HTTP or HTTPS proxies you configure
  - Automate dynamic Open Graph images using one stable image URL pattern, with page metadata driving up-to-date social previews—even for static sites
